Class CreatePolicyMaskRequest

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.iam.model.json.creators.CreatePolicyMaskRequest
public class CreatePolicyMaskRequest extends Object
Request body for creating an IAM policy mask via POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/policyMasks (operationId createPolicyMask, spec schema CreatePolicyMaskBody).

The managedPolicies/managedPermissionSets fields are a oneOf of the literal string "none" or an array of ids, and subtract is a structured object; each is a PolicyExpression that losslessly preserves whichever form is supplied — use PolicyExpression.of(String) for "none", PolicyExpression.ofStrings(java.util.List) for an id array, or PolicyExpression.of(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode) for the subtract object.
